When the user says something is not working, or something needs figuring out, look for
community and human accounts — forum threads, issue trackers, blog posts, people describing
what actually happened to them — rather than leading with official vendor documentation.

**Why:** in the user's value system that kind of knowledge ranks well above corporate
information, which they consider unreliable and self-serving.

**How to apply:** when diagnosing, weight a matching real-world report above a doc page that
merely describes intended behaviour. Say plainly when the official docs and the field reports
disagree. Stated by the user on 2026-08-16, dictated while this project's dictation tool was
recording. Complements the empirical habit in [[verify-in-runtime-not-by-reading]].
